edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the transfer origin and in pair/owner comparisons inside _transfer.
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing _msgSender() to _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing _msgSender() to _feeAddrWallet1.
renounceOwnership is gated by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender() to _owner.
Cooldown comparison and update in _transfer depend on block.timestamp.
The Uniswap swap deadline is set to block.timestamp.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
cooldown[to] is written as block.timestamp + 30 seconds.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth before finishing state updates when swapEnabled and not inSwap.
swapTokensForEth makes an external call into the Uniswap router, allowing callback re-entry.
_transfer triggers sendETHToFee which pushes ETH out during transfer processing.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet1.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet2.
openTrading calls the external addLiquidityETH router function.
manualswap reuses swapTokensForEth, the same external-call path.
manualsend reuses sendETHToFee, the same ETH push path.
_transfer reads cooldown[to] to gate transfers from the pair.
_maxTxAmount bounds the transfer amount in the cooldown branch.
The bots blacklist mapping is read to block addresses in _transfer.
_isExcludedFromFee is read to decide whether fee/swap logic applies.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from/to to detect buy/sell transfers.
uniswapV2Router address is compared against from/to in _transfer.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap-and-send block.
inSwap acts as the reentrancy guard read inside _transfer.
_transfer sets _feeAddr1 (tax fee) before computing transfer values.
_transfer sets _feeAddr2 (team fee) before computing transfer values.
_feeAddr1 feeds the tax fee argument of _getValues.
_feeAddr2 feeds the team fee argument of _getValues.
_transfer delegates the actual balance mutation to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard credits the team share via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies the fee via _reflectFee.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token-side amounts.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection-side amounts.
_getValues obtains the current rate from _getRate.
_getRate derives supplies via _getCurrentSupply.
tokenFromReflection uses _getRate to convert reflection amounts.
_rTotal is the reflection supply input of _getCurrentSupply.
_rTotal indirectly drives the division performed in _getRate.
_rTotal is reduced by rFee with SafeMath subtraction in _reflectFee.
_tFeeTotal is incremented by tFee with SafeMath addition in _reflectFee.
_rOwned entries of sender and recipient are subtracted and added in _transferStandard.
_takeTeam adds the team reflection amount to _rOwned[address(this)].
balanceOf converts _rOwned[account] through tokenFromReflection.
transferFrom moves funds through _transfer.
transferFrom updates the allowance through _approve.
transfer routes the call into _transfer.
approve writes allowances through _approve.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements _allowances[sender][spender].
setBots writes true into the bots blacklist mapping.
delBot writes false into the bots blacklist mapping.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
_feeAddrWallet1 is the destination of the first ETH transfer.
_feeAddrWallet2 is the destination of the second ETH transfer.
from parameter flows into the _transfer check and balance logic.
to parameter flows into the _transfer check and balance logic.
amount parameter flows into the _transfer amount validation.
tokenAmount parameter is the swap input of swapTokensForEth.
fee ETH amount parameter is split and forwarded in sendETHToFee.
bots_ array elements are written into the bots mapping by setBots.
notbot address is cleared in the bots mapping by delBot.
contractTokenBalance local is passed as the tokenAmount to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance local is passed as the amount to sendETHToFee.
sender parameter drives the transfer and allowance debit in transferFrom.
recipient parameter is the destination passed into _transfer from transferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to feed the _transfer authorization and balance logic.
The to parameter only exists to feed the _transfer authorization and balance logic.
The amount parameter only exists to feed the _transfer validation and transfer math.
tokenAmount is only used as the input of the swapTokensForEth external swap.
The ETH amount argument is only used inside sendETHToFee for splitting to fee wallets.
bots_ is only iterated and written into the bots mapping by setBots.
notbot is only used to clear a bots entry in delBot.
contractTokenBalance is a transient local that is immediately handed to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is a transient local that is immediately handed to sendETHToFee.
The sender parameter of transferFrom directly flows into the transfer and allowance debit.
The recipient parameter of transferFrom directly flows into the delegated transfer.
